title: Pixel Perfect Schema
description: Declarative pixel-art document: palettes, sprites, flipbooks (sprite animations), panels (compositions), timelines (panel animations) and scenes (multi-layer compositions). Ids are unique per resource type; `_*` fields hold the plain id of a resource of the type named by the key.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL of this schema, used by editors for validation and autocompletion. Ignored by the renderer.

palettes.description: Color palettes. Each maps single characters to RGBA colors and may derive from another palette.

sprites.description: Static images drawn as character grids, resolved through a palette.

flipbooks.description: Sprite-level animations: a sequence of sprites shown one after another.

panels.description: Single-plane compositions of sprites and flipbooks.

timelines.description: Panel-level animations: transitions applied over time to the elements of a panel.

scenes.description: Multi-plane compositions stacking panels and timelines as layers.

exports.description: Resources to rasterize to files, as pointers "/<collection>/<id>" (e.g. "/sprites/hero", "/scenes/night"). If omitted, every rasterizable resource is exported. Palettes cannot be exported. Output format (PNG/WebP, static or animated) is chosen on the command line, not here.
exports.$comment: Engine: every pointer must resolve to an existing resource.

id.description: Identifier, unique among resources of the same type.

ref.description: Plain id of a resource of the type named by the key (e.g. `_sprite` refers to a sprite id).
ref.$comment: Engine: must resolve to an existing resource of the expected type.

text.description: Free-form human-readable description. Ignored by the renderer.

fps.description: Frame-units per second. Every duration and frame index in the container is expressed in frame-units.

frameIndex.description: Frame-unit (0-based) of the containing timeline at which the change happens.

zIndex.description: Drawing order inside the container: higher values are drawn on top. Default 0. Ties are broken by array order (later entries are drawn on top).

transforms.description: Transformations applied in array order. After transforming, `coordinates` refers to the top-left corner of the transformed bounding box.

color.title: Color
color.description: A palette entry mapping one character to a color.

char.description: The character used in sprite lines for this color. Any single character except whitespace, control characters and the reserved `.` (transparent) and `=` (pass-through, see `overrideLines`).
char.$comment: Engine: must be unique inside the resolved palette.

rgba.description: Color as [red, green, blue] or [red, green, blue, alpha]. Channels are integers 0-255; alpha is a number 0.0-1.0, default 1.0 (opaque).

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: A named set of colors. With `_palette` it derives from another palette: it inherits all its colors and `colors` overrides or adds characters.

_palette.description: Id of the base palette to inherit colors from.

colors.description: Color entries. Required without `_palette`; with `_palette` they override the base entries with the same `char` and add new ones.

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: A geometric transformation of a sprite or flipbook frame. The fields depend on `kind`.

kind.description: flip: mirror on an axis; rotate: clockwise rotation; scale: resize with nearest-neighbor; crop: keep a rectangular area.

axis.description: x: mirror horizontally (left-right); y: mirror vertically (top-bottom).

then.description: Rotate the image clockwise. 90 and 270 swap width and height.
Resize the image to exactly `width` x `height` pixels using nearest-neighbor resampling.
Keep only a rectangular area of the image.

area.description: Area to keep as [x, y, width, height] in pixels, relative to the top-left corner of the image as it is at this point of the transform chain.
area.$comment: Engine: the area must lie inside the image.

sprite.title: Sprite
sprite.description: A static image drawn as a grid of characters. Each character is a color of the resolved palette; `.` is fully transparent. With `_sprite` it derives from another sprite and may change its palette and/or some lines.
sprite.$comment: Engine: all lines (after resolving inheritance) must have the same length; every character must exist in the resolved palette; detect inheritance cycles.

_sprite.description: Id of the base sprite. The derived sprite inherits its lines and palette; `_palette` replaces the palette and `overrideLines` replaces single lines. `lines` is not allowed.

_palette.description: Id of the palette resolving the characters. Required without `_sprite`; with `_sprite` it replaces the base sprite's palette.

width.description: Width in pixels. Optional: inferred from the lines. If present, the resolved lines must be exactly this wide.

height.description: Height in pixels. Optional: inferred from the lines. If present, the resolved sprite must have exactly this many lines.

lines.description: Rows of the image, top to bottom; one character per pixel, all rows the same length. `.` is transparent. Only for sprites without `_sprite`.

overrideLines.description: Lines replacing those of the base sprite, keyed by 0-based row index (e.g. {"3": "..rr.."}). Each value is a full-width row; the reserved character `=` copies the base sprite's character in the same column, which is then resolved with this sprite's palette. Only with `_sprite`.
overrideLines.$comment: Engine: indices must be < base height; each value must have the base width.

placement.description: Position of a region inside its container.

coordinates.description: [x, y] of the top-left corner in pixels, relative to the container's top-left corner. Values may be negative or exceed the container: whatever falls outside the container is clipped.

flipbook.title: Flipbook
flipbook.description: A sprite-level animation: frames shown in sequence on a fixed-size canvas, looping.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Frames are clipped to the canvas.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Frames are clipped to the canvas.

items.description: One frame: a sprite placed on the flipbook canvas for a number of frame-units.

_sprite.description: Id of the sprite shown in this frame.

duration.description: How many frame-units (see `fps`) this frame stays on screen.

element.title: Element
element.description: A sprite or flipbook placed inside a panel. Exactly one of `_sprite` and `_flipbook`.

id.description: Id unique inside the panel. Required if a timeline transition refers to this element.

_sprite.description: Id of the sprite to draw.

_flipbook.description: Id of the flipbook to play. In a timeline it plays with its own fps.

visible.description: Whether the element is drawn. Default true.

transition.title: Transition
transition.description: A change applied over time to an element of the timeline's panel. The fields depend on `kind`.

kind.description: moveTo: move gradually; setVisible: show/hide; moveToZ: change zIndex; appendTransforms: add transformations; resetTransforms: remove transformations added by transitions.

_element.description: Id of the target element, local to the timeline's panel.
_element.$comment: Engine: must match an `element.id` of the panel.

then.description: Move the element from its position at `start` to `coordinates`, reaching it at `start + duration`. Linear interpolation, rounded to the nearest pixel at every frame-unit.

start.description: Frame-unit at which the movement starts.

duration.description: Number of frame-units the movement lasts.

then.description: Set the element's visibility at frame-unit `at`.
Move the element to a new zIndex at frame-unit `at`.
Append transformations after the element's current ones at frame-unit `at`.
Remove every transformation added by `appendTransforms` at frame-unit `at`; the element's own `transforms` are kept.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: A single-plane composition of elements on a fixed-size canvas.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Elements are clipped to the canvas.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Elements are clipped to the canvas.

elements.description: Elements drawn in zIndex order (ties: array order).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: A panel-level animation: starts from the panel's state and applies transitions over `duration` frame-units, looping.

_panel.description: Id of the panel giving canvas size and initial state.

duration.description: Total length of the timeline in frame-units.

transitions.description: Transitions applied to the panel's elements.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: A panel or timeline placed inside a scene. Exactly one of `_panel` and `_timeline`.

scene.title: Scene
scene.description: A multi-plane composition: layers stacked on a fixed-size canvas.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Layers are clipped to the canvas.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Layers are clipped to the canvas.

layers.description: Layers drawn in zIndex order (ties: array order).
